title: Scheduled backup with retention
goal: The hub backs itself up on a schedule and prunes old copies
acceptance: The hub (or a documented systemd timer/cron entry shipped in the repository) runs the backup daily to a configured directory and keeps the last N copies (N configurable, default 7); a failed backup is logged and raises a hub alert
Documentation names the schedule, directory and retention
Failing test committed first: a test that advances the clock and expects a copy per day and at most N copies fails before the scheduler exists; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: A scheduler, retention and an alert on failure; the backup command exists. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
